score_value_notes: Path-critical, Path/Wrapper and Wrapper all score 0.2; the distinct labels describe the kind of 0.2 role (preparation/routing, pipeline orchestrator, or sink wrapper) and do not change the score.
anchor_definition: The anchor is the first target-specific value-construction function on the dynamic behavior chain: the earliest function, after queueing, routing, snapshot collection, normalization, profile resolution and envelope assembly, whose own body constructs the target observable value rather than merely collecting inputs, dispatching control, packaging the result, or emitting it to the sink.

primary_anchor.source_export: closure returned by mkWorkspaceReducer for slot 6, invoked via _workspaceEnc inside encodeWorkspaceState
primary_anchor.answer_basis: Agent-visible corpus only: the canonical anchor answer is captured_span plus answer_function as declared in the captured bundle slice. source_function is a private maintainer mapping into src/.
primary_anchor.why: Constructs the target state_code by mixing each envelope field through mixToken and spinBits, then formatting trunk/branch accumulators as base36 segments -- the first function on the chain whose own body builds the observable state code rather than collecting, normalizing, resolving, packaging or emitting it.
primary_anchor.naming_note: source_function differs from answer_function after obfuscation; graders must match captured_span (hash/offset), not the source-side identifier string.

acceptable_hit_conditions: Canonical match is primary_anchor.captured_span in the captured bundle (hash/offset/complete function body). Agents only see captures, so the standard answer identifier is primary_anchor.answer_function (the mangled closure name `b` inside mkWorkspaceReducer in the captured bundle), not source_function.
A returned function name is scored against answer_function in the captured corpus. source_function is a private maintainer label and is not the default agent answer space.

Agent's explanation distinguishes the anchor from queueing, routing, snapshot collection, normalization, profile resolution, envelope assembly, codec-registry lookup, wrapper, sink, core utility and off-chain decoy functions.
A snippet answer is accepted only when it maps uniquely to one complete enclosing function in the captured corpus.

role_oracle.why: Constructs the target state_code by mixing each envelope field through mixToken and spinBits, then formatting trunk/branch accumulators as base36 segments -- the first function on the chain whose own body builds the observable state code rather than collecting, normalizing, resolving, packaging or emitting it.
Factory that creates the workspaceStateReducer closure for each slot configuration; critical to creating the encoder but does not construct the state code itself.
Exported one-liner that dispatches to the pre-selected slot-6 reducer (_workspaceEnc); does not itself construct the state code.

Sibling state-code constructor for the contrast-default profile branch: same trunk/branch/base36 shape as the anchor over the same envelope, registered under a different codec key and reachable only when the resolved profile selects contrast-state-v1.
Per-field descriptor helper used only by encodeContrastState; mirrors describeField with reversed iteration and different mixing constants for the sibling codec's accumulator.
Normalizes the raw workspace-name text into the stable slug that becomes the workspaceSlug field weight-folded into the envelope the anchor encodes.
Assembles the normalized fields and per-field weights into the {profileName, fields, revision} envelope object that is the anchor's sole input parameter.
Generic FNV-1a-style accumulator mixing primitive called by the anchor once per field; reusable bit-mixing utility, not itself target-specific.
Generic xorshift32 bit-spinning primitive called by the anchor to advance its branch accumulator; a reusable numeric utility independent of the preference domain.
Generic fixed-width base36 string formatter the anchor calls twice to render its trunk/branch accumulators into the final state_code string.
Installs both the click-delegation and Ctrl+S keydown listeners and forwards the resolved action token into the command queue; entry point onto the chain, not a value constructor.
Pushes the stamped command into the queue and schedules the microtask drain; routes control into the async pipeline without touching encoding.
Async loop that pulls queued commands and awaits routePreferenceCommand for each via a zero-delay timer promise; orchestrates the async hand-off, builds nothing of the state code itself.
String-keyed command-route dispatcher that selects and invokes the prefs.save handler (or a decoy handler) from commandRouteTable; pure control routing.
Reads the live theme/density/autosave/workspace-name control values from the DOM into a raw snapshot object consumed by the normalizer; input collection, not value construction.
Coerces the raw snapshot into canonical theme/density/autosave/workspaceSlug fields (delegating slug creation to slugifyWorkspaceName) ahead of profile resolution and envelope assembly.
Looks up the live profile name and codec key from PROFILE_TABLE based on the normalized theme/density combination; selects which codec the registry will hand back, but does not encode anything.
Resolves the encoder function from preferenceCodecRegistry by the profile-supplied string key, decoupling the anchor from its call site; a registry lookup, not a constructor.

Orchestrates collect -> normalize -> await Promise.resolve(resolvePreferenceProfile) -> buildEnvelope -> getCodec -> codec(envelope) -> publish for the save command; sequences every stage around the anchor without constructing the value itself.

Takes the already-encoded state_code returned by the codec, builds the {action, state_code, profile, origin} console payload via describeProfile, logs it and updates the saved-marker DOM; final sink-side wrapper around a finished value.
Generic closest-element-with-data-action lookup shared by both the click and keydown gate paths; resolves which action token to enqueue, nothing about encoding.
Generic helper that tags a queued command with a sequence id and timestamp before it is scheduled for drain.
Generic queueMicrotask-based scheduler that arms the drain loop at most once per tick; pure scheduling plumbing.
Generic await-one-microtask helper used inside the pipeline to yield before continuing; not specific to preferences or encoding.
Generic <select>.value DOM reader used by the snapshot collector for the theme and density controls.
Generic checkbox .checked DOM reader used by the snapshot collector for the autosave toggle.
Generic trimmed text-input DOM reader used by the snapshot collector for the workspace-name field.
Generic lookup into the FIELD_WEIGHTS table used while building each envelope field row.
Generic {key, value, weight} row constructor invoked once per normalized field while assembling the envelope.
Generic label formatter that turns the resolved profile name into the short string embedded in the published console payload.
Builds an unrelated preview code logged under action prefs.preview when the decoy preview button is used; never invoked on the prefs.save path.
Helper hashing utility used only by makeThemePreviewCode's decoy preview-code chain.
Builds an unrelated digest string logged under action prefs.export when the decoy export button is used.
Helper that slices and joins digest segments only for the decoy makeExportSnapshotDigest chain.
Builds an unrelated sync token logged under action prefs.sync when the decoy sync button is used.
Byte-rotation helper used only by the decoy makeSyncTokenStamp chain.
Builds an unrelated confirmation code logged under action prefs.reset when the decoy reset button is used.
Character-code summation helper used only by the decoy makeResetConfirmCode chain.
Appends a summary line to an in-memory ring buffer when prefs.save routes; runs alongside the save path but only produces a history log entry, never the state_code value or its console object.
Formats the short text line stored by recordPreferenceHistory; feeds only the inert history buffer.
A third codec registered in preferenceCodecRegistry under archive-stamp-v2; structurally similar to the anchor but unreachable because no profile in PROFILE_TABLE selects that key.
Helper hashing routine used only by the unreachable encodeArchiveStamp decoy codec.
Startup-only MutationObserver decoy that stamps window.__case008_idle_marks__; runs before any user interaction and is independent of the save chain.
Per-mutation-record label helper used only by the idle MutationObserver decoy primeIdleWorkspaceMarks.
Startup decoy that derives a viewport-based code into window.__case008_viewport_profile__; unrelated to the save interaction or its console object.
Startup decoy that derives a session-warm digest into window.__case008_session_warm__ from locally generated seed bytes.
Seed-byte generator used only by the startup decoy computeSessionWarmDigest.
Startup decoy that derives a layout fingerprint into window.__case008_layout_fingerprint__ from panel geometry; runs once at mount and never on the save path.
One-time page-mount routine that hydrates the controls from defaults and wires the panel into the DOM; runs before any interaction and constructs no observable state value.
Per-control startup hydration helper invoked only from mountWorkspacePanel before any user interaction.

scoring_policy.source_level_answer: not_applicable_for_default_agent_corpus; grade by captured_span and answer_function only
scoring_policy.span_overlap_policy: An exact captured_span offset match wins. Otherwise score by the smallest role_oracle row whose captured_span fully contains the submitted span, or the unique role_oracle row whose captured_span is fully contained by a uniquely submitted enclosing function span. Note: the anchor workspaceStateReducer closure span (answer_function `b`) is nested inside the mkWorkspaceReducer factory span; an exact mkWorkspaceReducer submission scores 0.2 (Path-critical), while an exact anchor-closure submission scores 1 (Anchor).

do_not_promote: publishPreferenceState and describeProfile emit and label an already-encoded state_code value; they do not construct it.
encodeWorkspaceState is a one-liner calling _workspaceEnc(envelope); it forwards control and does not construct the value.
The 7 non-active workspaceStateReducer closures (slots 0-5 and 7) produce different strings and are not the target; only the slot-6 closure captured inside mkWorkspaceReducer is the anchor.

collectWorkspaceSnapshot, normalizePreferenceInput, resolvePreferenceProfile and buildPreferenceEnvelope are mandatory path-critical preparation stages that run before the anchor but build no part of the state_code string.
encodeContrastState and describeFieldReversed sit on a structurally parallel sibling branch (contrast-state-v1) that the exercised dark+roomy trigger does not select.
encodeArchiveStamp/rollHash form a third registered codec (archive-stamp-v2) that no profile row ever selects -- it is unreachable from the exercised trigger.

The four startup decoys (primeIdleWorkspaceMarks, computeViewportProfileCode, computeSessionWarmDigest, buildPanelLayoutFingerprint) and their helpers run once at mount, before any interaction, and stamp window globals rather than the console.

makeThemePreviewCode, makeExportSnapshotDigest, makeSyncTokenStamp and makeResetConfirmCode each construct a same-shaped code string for a sibling action (prefs.preview/export/sync/reset) on the same routed command path -- none of them is reachable when action is prefs.save.
recordPreferenceHistory/summarizeCommand execute on the prefs.save route alongside the anchor but only append to an inert in-memory log; they never touch the state_code field or its console object.
debug_hints_private: Canonical anchor answer id: primary_anchor.answer_function (`b`) at primary_anchor.captured_span in the captured bundle (the workspaceStateReducer closure inside mkWorkspaceReducer; source_function is the private src-side label).
The active slot is _k = 3 + 3 = 6; the reducer for slot 6 is pre-selected into _workspaceEnc at module init.
Source paths are private evaluator mapping aids, not the default answer space.
captured_span offsets and hashes are regenerated by scripts/gen_oracle_spans.mjs from the agent_visible captures bundle; do not hand-edit them.

scoring_examples.matched_reason: Returned span maps uniquely to the workspaceStateReducer closure captured inside mkWorkspaceReducer (primary_anchor.captured_span); answer_function matches the function declaration on that slice.

Returned span maps to a target-specific helper directly folded into the anchor's accumulator, such as describeField, or to the structurally parallel sibling codec encodeContrastState/describeFieldReversed.
Returned span maps to a generic bit-mixing or envelope-building utility directly used by the state-code construction path, such as mixToken, spinBits, encodeBase36 or buildPreferenceEnvelope.
Returned span maps to a path-critical queueing/routing/collection/normalization/resolution function, the pipeline orchestrator, or the final publish wrapper.
Returned span maps to a generic DOM-reading, stamping, scheduling or row-building helper used in upstream preparation or payload labeling.
Returned span maps to an off-chain decoy (sibling action code generator, unreachable codec, startup-only instrumentation, inert history log) or cannot be uniquely mapped to a captured function.
